rationale: Most of the GT's headline P1s (Cache-DiT transformers_ref lifecycle, ModularPipeline metadata, Ref2VA implicit default) are already marked 'Fixed in <sha>' and the visible diff shows the corresponding fix artifacts (e.g. the new test_enable_and_refresh_every_declared_dit test), so neither candidate needed to (and didn't) re-flag them; neither caught SamitHuang's four code-quality nits either, keeping both recalls low. X's strongest hit is a precise, well-evidenced catch that the Qwen3-TTS task-type validator gates on a non-production arch string, closely tracking GT's TTS validation concern. Y covers similar TTS-validation ground less precisely but adds broader, higher-severity findings (a plausible crash regression for Bagel/SenseNova via getattr-vs-attrgetter on dotted _dit_modules paths, a partition-directory-naming crash) with reproduction transcripts, giving it a slight edge in coverage/value despite a bit more speculative surface area (self-flagged 'not yet firing' items, a shakier MODEL_ROOT doc claim) that trims its precision somewhat.
